chunks: We had taken the pledge of those also who call themselves Christians. But they too forgot to take advantage of the warning they were given. So We have caused enmity and hatred among them to last till the Day of Resurrection, when God will inform them of what they were doing.
ai.seo_question: Why did God place enmity among the Christians according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Banu al-Nasara's breach of the covenant by neglecting the divine portion of their teachings, leading to internal discord that persists until the Day of Judgment. The phrase 'hadhdhan' (portion) is often interpreted as referring to the specific duties or the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) himself, which they failed to uphold. This neglect resulted in divine retribution in the form of enduring enmity among their sects, serving as a sign for their deviation from monotheism.
